image_description: A side-profile view of a small, slender mustelid (likely a stoat or weasel) standing on rough, rocky ground. The animal has a long, tubular body with brown fur on its back and head, transitioning to creamy white/yellow on its underside and throat. It has short legs, a pointed snout, small dark eyes, and rounded ears. The tail is relatively long and slender, ending in a darker tip. The background consists of blurred earthy mounds and sparse green vegetation.
